role: CI gate (App Review 5.1.3(ii)): CloudKit*.swift must not write health scalars to CKRecord fields, legacy settings fields may only be set to nil, named payload builders must encode through CloudPayloadCodec with a hasUsableKey guard, and named readers must decode before decompressing.
toplevel: cd to repo root. No Emuqu/Sources/Storage/CloudKit*.swift -> exit 2. grep 1: `record["<health field>"] =` -> error each. grep 2: settingsJSON/legacyJSONField/deviceName/legacyDeviceNameField assignments not ending in `= nil` -> error. Loop over compressedPayload, compressedPoints, encryptedSettingsPayload: file not found -> skipped; awk body to first 4-space `}`; body lacks CloudPayloadCodec.encode / *ncryptedFor*( -> error; file lacks CloudPayloadCodec.hasUsableKey -> error. Loop over liveBackupSummary, decodeSessionPayload: not found -> skipped; body decompresses without CloudPayloadCodec.decode -> error. bad>0 -> exit 1; else clean.

flags.text: Reader/writer checks skip any function name that is not found: `decodeSessionPayload` does not exist (the session reader is CloudPullCoordinator.decodeSessionAsset in CloudKitSyncManager+Pull.swift), so the session-payload decrypt-before-decompress check verifies nothing; renaming any listed writer disables its check too.

Only files named Storage/CloudKit*.swift are scanned, and only literal-string keys `record["x"] =`. CloudHealthScrubCoordinator.swift writes record["sessionData"] and TrashRestoreCoordinator/SettingsManager touch CKRecords outside that glob; writes through key constants (record[payloadField]) or setValue are not matched.
